demo.dialogue.awakening.node.smoke.text: Smoke on the horizon. Where there is smoke, there are people.
demo.dialogue.awakening.node.where.text: Where am I? My head rings like a struck bell.
demo.dialogue.awakening.node.whisper.tex: ...wake up. Someone is waiting for you.
demo.dialogue.elder.node.again.text: You again? Just kidding, come in.
demo.dialogue.elder.node.bell.text: My grandfathers cast the bell. It only rings when it means it.
demo.dialogue.elder.node.fish.text: Take this fish. Show it to her and she'll come. Hurry though: by nightfall the foxes will find her first.
demo.dialogue.elder.node.friend.text: Ah, %s! A friend of the Ford is always welcome.
demo.dialogue.elder.node.harvest_paid.te: Twelve sheaves, just as agreed. Here's your pay.
demo.dialogue.elder.node.harvest_short.t: That's less than twelve. The village fields still have plenty.
demo.dialogue.elder.node.hub.options.mor: The elder doesn't trust you enough yet: after Night Watch, relationship 10 or more
demo.dialogue.elder.node.hub.options.rea: The Reaper is gone, I can't find it.
About the Reaper... I've changed my mind.
demo.dialogue.elder.node.hub.options.tra: Show me what you have to trade.
What do you think of me?
demo.dialogue.elder.node.lost.text: It hides until it hears the bell. I'll sound the alarm. Brace yourself!
demo.dialogue.elder.node.mines.text: They say something ancient sleeps in the old mines under the hill. I don't go there.
demo.dialogue.elder.node.murka.text: There is. Murka, my cat, ran off again. She's skittish: afraid of strangers.
demo.dialogue.elder.node.murka_back.text: Murka! You little bandit... Thank you, %s. You're a true friend.
demo.dialogue.elder.node.neutral.text: Still taking your measure. Deeds speak louder than words.
demo.dialogue.elder.node.no_work.text: Murka is asleep by the stove, the bell is quiet. Rest a while.
demo.dialogue.elder.node.quiet.text: The bell is quiet today. That's good.
demo.dialogue.elder.node.reported.text: Then the Ford will sleep soundly again. Tikhon would be proud of you.
demo.dialogue.elder.node.reward.text: Your reward is waiting in the journal: claim it, you've earned it. And there's a new notice on the board for you.
demo.dialogue.elder.node.river.text: They named the Ford after the shallow river: in summer a chicken could cross it.
demo.dialogue.elder.node.trusted.text: You're a friend of the Ford. I'd trust you with the bell.
demo.dialogue.elder_busy.node.busy.text: Hold on, I'm talking with another traveller.
demo.dialogue.elder_meeting.node.accepte: Then take Tikhon's journal. Stock up on torches: the Reaper hates fire. And come to me after sunset.
demo.dialogue.elder_meeting.node.bread.t: Warm bread from a stranger... It's been a long time. Thank you.
demo.dialogue.elder_meeting.node.cat.tex: Ha! You haven't met my cat yet. Now that is work.
demo.dialogue.elder_meeting.node.few_han: Plenty of work, too few hands. Especially now.
demo.dialogue.elder_meeting.node.hello.t: Welcome to Quiet Ford, traveller. The bell never lies: it hears guests before the dogs do.
demo.dialogue.elder_meeting.node.offer.o: I'll help. What do I do?
And what's in it for me?
demo.dialogue.elder_meeting.node.pay.tex: Emeralds from the treasury and the best from the smithy. And my gratitude: it's worth a lot around here.
demo.dialogue.elder_meeting.node.refused: I understand. If you change your mind, find me by the bell.
demo.dialogue.elder_meeting.node.ringing: The bell? I thought the ringing was in my head.
demo.dialogue.elder_meeting.node.smoke.t: That was the watch fire. For three nights something has come out of the dark: a pumpkin for a head, a sickle in its hand.
Our watchman Tikhon went after it and never came back. All that's left is his journal.
I followed the smoke. What was burning?
demo.dialogue.elder_meeting.node.who.tex: Miron, the elder here. Forty winters I've made sure the Ford has bread, roofs and a ringing bell.
demo.dialogue.elder_meeting.node.work.te: Sounds like a lot of work.
demo.dialogue.elder_night.node.act.optio: Sound the alarm! Let people hide.
Take a torch and go meet it.
demo.dialogue.elder_night.node.bolted.te: Good! Doors are bolted, and you and I will greet our guest.
demo.dialogue.elder_night.node.brave.tex: Reckless... but brave. Tikhon was the same.
demo.dialogue.elder_night.node.coward.te: Behind me? I'm an old man, not a castle wall!
demo.dialogue.elder_night.node.frozen.te: Don't just stand there! There it is, by the fence!
demo.dialogue.elder_night.node.here.text: It's here. Decide quickly: what will you do?
demo.dialogue.elder_night.node.silence.t: Hear that? Silence. Even the dogs have gone quiet.
demo.dialogue.elder_not_yet.node.early.t: Too early. The Reaper comes after sunset.
demo.dialogue.elder_not_yet.node.torches: See to your torches and come back at dusk.
demo.dialogue.farewell.node.bell.text: The bell will call if we need you.
demo.dialogue.murka.node.found.text: There you are, runaway. Come on, I'll walk you home.
demo.dialogue.reaper_sighted.node.promis: Tikhon, I'll finish what you started.
There it is... The pumpkin glows from within, the sickle crusted with old blood.

demo.quest.festival.on_complete.0.title: Thank you, %s!
demo.quest.festival.stages.bell.log: I need to come to the village bell at sunset.
demo.quest.festival.stages.bell.objectiv: It's still light: the festival starts at sunset.
Already by the bell? Step a dozen paces away and come back.
Come to the bell in the evening
demo.quest.festival.stages.invite.log: The elder sent me a letter.
demo.quest.festival.text.active: The Ford is holding a festival in my honour. It starts at sunset, by the bell.
demo.quest.festival.text.completed: Fireworks, music and a book as a gift. This story will go on, and you can write the rest.
demo.quest.festival.title: Festival by the Bell
demo.quest.harvest.stages.deliver.log: Gather 12 sheaves of wheat and bring them to the elder.
demo.quest.harvest.stages.deliver.object: Wheat grows on the village fields. Break the ripe ones and plant the seeds back: be polite.
demo.quest.harvest.text.active: The Ford can't bring the harvest in alone. The elder pays for every twelve sheaves.
demo.quest.harvest.text.completed: Wheat in the barn, emeralds in my pocket. I can do it again tomorrow.
demo.quest.harvest.title: Our Daily Bread
The elder's cat loves cod and sleeps by the stove. If she runs off again, I know what to do.
demo.quest.murka.stages.return.log: Murka ate the fish and now won't leave my side. Time to walk her home to the elder.
demo.quest.murka.stages.return.objective: Murka follows you like a tamed cat: just walk, she'll keep up.
Walk Murka home to the elder
demo.quest.murka.stages.search.log: The elder gave me fish. The marker shows roughly where Murka wanders.
demo.quest.murka.stages.search.objective: Hold the fish: a skittish cat comes to whoever holds cod or salmon. Then press H.
demo.quest.murka.text.active: The elder's cat ran off past the fence. She fears strangers, but loves fish more than she fears.
demo.quest.murka.text.completed: Murka is home, curled up at the elder's feet. The elder looks at me more warmly now.
demo.quest.murka.text.failed: I didn't make it in time. Murka came back on her own, but the elder is upset.
demo.quest.murka.title: Skittish Murka
demo.quest.night_watch.stages.dusk.log: The torches are ready. The Reaper comes after sunset, and the elder will be waiting.
demo.quest.night_watch.stages.dusk.objec: The sun is still high. The elder will only talk about the Reaper after sunset.
It's dark: find the elder by his marker and press H.
Come to the elder after sunset
demo.quest.night_watch.stages.fight.log: The Reaper stepped out of the dark. The bell rings, thunder rolls: it's time.
demo.quest.night_watch.stages.fight.obje: The pumpkin shields the Reaper from the sun. Follow the orange marker.
Lost it? Ask the elder: he will call it with the bell.
demo.quest.night_watch.stages.prepare.lo: The elder gave me Tikhon's journal. I need torches: the Reaper fears fire.
demo.quest.night_watch.stages.prepare.ob: Torch: coal or charcoal above a stick.
demo.quest.night_watch.stages.report.log: The Reaper is dead. The elder should hear it first.
demo.quest.night_watch.text.active: For three nights the Pumpkin Reaper has haunted Quiet Ford. Tikhon the watchman is gone, and now the watch is mine.
demo.quest.night_watch.text.completed: The Reaper is slain, and above the Ford shine stars again, not fires.
demo.quest.night_watch.title: Night Watch
demo.quest.smoke_on_the_horizon.stages.m: As I reached the houses, a bell rang and an old man came out to meet me.
Walk up to the elder and press H (Talk).
demo.quest.smoke_on_the_horizon.stages.r: The marker on the horizon points to the nearest village. Time to go.
Villages stand in plains, deserts, savannas, taigas and snowy plains. No marker means none was found nearby: travel further.
Monsters roam at night: wait it out under a roof.
Already in a village? Step out past its houses and walk back in.
demo.quest.smoke_on_the_horizon.text.act: I woke up in unfamiliar lands. Smoke rises in the distance: people must live there.
demo.quest.smoke_on_the_horizon.text.com: The village is called Quiet Ford, and I was greeted like a long-awaited guest.
demo.quest.smoke_on_the_horizon.title: Smoke on the Horizon
